resumeRequired: Explicit user resume and parent admission; do not execute during USER-RUNTIME-HOLD

format.source: selected Windows playback endpoint system mix, not isolated game or microphone

admission: Verify optional soundcard/numpy/soundfile dependencies through parent's existing runtime; do not install or probe devices now
After resume list endpoints and bind unique actual game endpoint; tone self-test is optional and is not game-route proof
Parent checks storage and existing live recorder/session ownership before starting once
windowAndNativeControl: None; helper only captures audio. Parent retains normal native lifecycle and current user's session
synchronization: Start once just before the audio block's already-coordinated video; retain actual UTC start/end, worldMs phase clocks and visible/audible engine-start landmark. Measure actual mux offset/uncertainty; never assume example2seconds
stop: Parent creates only this run's chosen stop file after last audio case to finalize this recorder, or lets600s bound finish. No window-close/process-kill or game exit is part of recorder stop
timing: Common sequence minimum79world seconds per pass; four passes minimum316seconds plus qualified reset/sync pauses.600s is capture fallback, not a test timeout or user-window timer. If needed use a fresh subsequent audio segment in the SAME consolidated world session after prior recorder finalizes
review: Retain finalized WAV+recorder stdout/stderr and native video; inspect and hash after closure. Endpoint mix can include other apps. A nonzero waveform/peak/RMS or tone does not establish audible rolling or sound quality
postprocess: Use existing screen:record/screen:clip workflow only under parent coordination. No new recorder/controller; review all A/B clips at one common gain, no per-clip loudness normalization
